observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa pagsasanay ng magkapares, nagbigay ng paanyaya ang BHW, umangkop sa tugon ng residente, nagsabi ng tiyak na obserbasyon nang walang hinalang sanhi, at pinangalanan ang lalapitan sa lokal na pagpaplano.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In the paired role-play, the BHW invited participation, adapted to the resident's response, reported a specific observation without claiming a cause, and named whom to approach through local planning.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa nakapagbigay ng paanyayang may puwang sa tugon ng residente o nakapaghiwalay ng nakita sa hinala.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Has not yet made an invitation that allows a resident to respond or separated what was seen from an assumption.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagawa ang paanyaya, pagtugon, pag-uulat ng nakita, at pagtukoy ng lokal na lalapitan nang walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Invites, responds, reports what was seen, and names the local contact without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang mga hakbang matapos tanungin kung ano ang nakita, kailan maaari ang residente, o kanino lalapit.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the steps after prompts about what was seen, when the resident is available, or whom to approach.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nag-anunsyo lamang, hindi tumugon, naghahayag ng hinalang sanhi, o nangangako ng pondo kahit may gabay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Only announces, does not respond, claims an unverified cause, or promises funding despite prompts.
